prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” dentist for implants in Dallas — the right provider depends on your case (simple vs complex), whether you need bone grafting/sinus lift, your insurance/ budget, and whether you prefer a specialist (oral surgeon or periodontist) or a general dentist who places implants.

How to find the best provider for your situation
- Prefer specialists for implants: look for a board-certified oral & maxillofacial surgeon or a periodontist for placement. A prosthodontist or experienced restorative dentist should do the crown/restoration. Many great teams coordinate care.
- Check credentials: board certification, membership in AAOMS/AAID/AAIP/AAOP, years of implant experience, fellowship training.
- Look for tech and planning: in‑house CBCT (3D cone beam), guided implant planning, digital impressions, and ability to do bone grafting/sinus lifts if needed.
- Review outcomes and transparency: before/after photos, patient testimonials, complication and success rates, clear written cost estimate and treatment timeline.
- Practical factors: location, sedation options, payment/financing, and whether they accept your insurance.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- How many implants do you place per year and what’s your success rate?
- Are you board-certified? What training do you have in implants?
- Will you get a CBCT scan and a written digital treatment plan?
- What implant system do you use (Straumann, Nobel, etc.) and why?
- Who will do the final crown — you or a restorative dentist/prosthodontist?
- What are total costs, including grafts, temporaries, and the final crown?
- What is the timeline and follow‑up schedule? What is your complication policy?

Directories and ways to search
- AAOMS (American Association of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons) – “Find a Surgeon”
- AAID (American Academy of Implant Dentistry) – “Find an Implant Dentist”
- Local dental society listings, Google Maps/Hospital affiliations, Healthgrades, RealSelf/Yelp for patient reviews
- Ask your general dentist for referrals — they often work with local implant surgeons and prosthodontists

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated implant specialists in Dallas (I’ll need your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you prefer oral surgeon/periodontist or have an insurance network), or
- Provide a prioritized checklist for evaluating 3–4 dentists you already have in mind.
